description: Ben and his trained dog, Sancho, run away from the circus and soon find a warm welcome in a kind community where spirited games are played. Theatricals and imaginative pageantry are all part of the fun.
title: Under the Lilacs

first_sentence.value: The elm-tree avenue was all overgrown, the great gate was never unlocked, and the old house had been shut up for several years.
